problem:
Evaluate the triple integral 

$$
{∭}_{R}6{y}^{2}\,dV
$$

where $R$ is the type I region given by 

$$
R={(x,y,z)\,:\,0\le x\le 1,\,0\le y\le x,\,0\le z\le x+y}.
$$
worked_solution:
Writing down our triple integral as a repeated integral, we obtain

$$
{∭}_{R}6{y}^{2}\,\text{d}V={\int }_{-1}^{0}{\int }_{1}^{x}{\int }_{0}^{x+y}6{y}^{2}\,dz\,dy\,dx.
$$

First, we evaluate the inner integral with respect to $z$, treating $x$ and $y$ as constants: 

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{0}^{x}{\int }_{0}^{x+y}6{y}^{2}\,dz\,dy\,dx & ={\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{0}^{x}[{\int }_{0}^{x+y}6{y}^{2}\,dz]dy\,dx \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{0}^{x}[6{y}^{2}z]_{z=0}^{z=x+y}\,dy\,dx \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{0}^{x}6{y}^{2}(x+y)\,dy\,dx \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{0}^{x}6x{y}^{2}+6{y}^{3}\,dy\,dx\end{aligned}
$$

Next, we evaluate the inner integral with respect to $y$, treating $x$ as a constant: 

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{0}^{x}6x{y}^{2}+6{y}^{3}\,dy\,dx & ={\int }_{0}^{1}[{\int }_{0}^{x}6x{y}^{2}+6{y}^{3}\,dy]dx \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}{[2x{y}^{3}+\frac{3}{2}{y}^{4}]}_{y=0}^{y=x}\,dx \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}2{x}^{4}+\frac{3}{2}{x}^{4}\,dx \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}\frac{7}{2}{x}^{4}\,dx\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we integrate with respect to $x:$

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{1}\frac{7}{2}{x}^{4}\,dx & ={[\frac{7}{10}{x}^{5}]}_{x=0}^{x=1} \\  & =\frac{7}{10}(1-0) \\  & =\frac{7}{10}.\end{aligned}
$$
